headline: Public hearings on variance requests for 86 Dessa Drive and 104 Lincoln Street.
summary: Lisa Haylon asks for a 7-foot side yard setback where 12 feet is required. Colleen and Ernesto Amaro ask for a 7.67-foot side yard setback and 37% impervious coverage.
items: Public hearing on Variance #26-6740, 86 Dessa Drive: 7-foot side yard setback where 12 feet is required
Public hearing on Variance #26-6741, 104 Lincoln Street: 7.67-foot side yard setback where 12 feet is required
Public hearing on Variance #26-6741, 104 Lincoln Street: 37% impervious coverage where 30% is allowed
Regular meeting review of Variance #26-6740, 86 Dessa Drive
Regular meeting review of Variance #26-6741, 104 Lincoln Street
location: 3rd Floor Conference Room, Hamden Government Center, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT, and on Zoom
